title: Custom 404, 500 & not-found Pages
description: Delight users with branded error pages and understand the difference between not-found and error boundaries.

slides.title: HTTP Errors ≠ Component Errors 🚦
slides.content:
# Different Error Types

* **Rendering errors** (crashes) → caught by error boundaries (`error.js`).
* **Not Found (404)** → resource doesn't exist, handled by `not-found.js` or `pages/404.js`.
* **Server errors (500)** → catch‑all for unexpected failures on the server.

Next.js provides dedicated files for each, plus the programmatic `notFound()` function to trigger them.

slides.title: App Router: `not-found.js` (app/not-found.js)
slides.content: This renders for any unmatched route or when `notFound()` is called.

quizData.question: How do you programmatically trigger the 404 page from a Server Component?
quizData.explanation: `notFound()` from `next/navigation` triggers the nearest `not-found.js` page in the App Router.

slides.title: Pages Router Error Pages 📚
Pages Router 404 (pages/404.js)
slides.content: A classic custom 404 with a link home.

quizData.question: When is `pages/_error.js` rendered instead of `pages/404.js`?

options.text: For any error on the server, including 500 errors

quizData.explanation: `_error.js` is a catch‑all for server errors, including 500, while `404.js` specifically handles Not Found.

slides.title: Programmatic notFound in Data Fetching 📦
User Experience ✨
slides.content: Make your error pages helpful: include a search bar, link to popular pages, or a dash of humor. A good 404 can turn frustration into a smile.
